description: Agent preflight round 2: check recovery arrangements before you depend on them. Input text, fields (backups, key_recovery, export_paths, restore_steps, restore_test) or both. The signed report marks backups and their recency, the key recovery method, export paths for records and catalogs, restore steps and evidence the restore was tested ready, partial or missing, with quotes, and names the weakest links plainly, missing first. POST /api/recovery-readiness-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no registry or chain lookup, no counterparty contact, and no payment signed, submitted or moved. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-preflight-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/preflight/.

inputSchema.description: Send the text, the fields or both.

fields.description: The arrangements by area. A field given here takes precedence over the text for that area.

backups.description: What is backed up, how often, where, and the date of the last backup.

export_paths.description: How records and catalogs are exported, and where.

key_recovery.description: How a lost key is recovered.

restore_steps.description: The restore steps, or where the runbook is.

restore_test.description: Evidence the restore was tested: when and how.

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

label.description: Optional name for the material, recorded in the report.

text.description: The recovery arrangements as written, up to 64 KB.

name: wever_recovery-readiness-check
title: Recovery readiness check
